subject: English
title: CBSE English, Class VIII

source.read: Directorate of Education, Delhi: Class VIII English annual syllabus 2026-27, built on the NCERT textbook Poorvi (NCF-SE 2023) that CBSE schools use
source.note: UNOFFICIAL SOURCE. CBSE does not publish a line-by-line English syllabus below Class 9; this list follows a state education department's year plan for the NCERT book Poorvi, read through a text summary of the PDF. Chapters are named by kind, not reproduced.

licence: Strand names as printed (facts). Every outcome is written by OpenPath in its own words; no curriculum or textbook text is reproduced.
review: OpenPath curriculum inventory (AI-assisted research from secondary sources; not an educator review)

outcomes.text: Listens to a passage: orders events, matches speakers and completes sentences.
Takes part in group and panel discussions and presentations.
outcomes.note: Done aloud with a grown-up, who ticks what they heard. The app cannot hear or mark speaking.

outcomes.text: Makes requests, suggestions, offers and apologies.
outcomes.note: Polite forms are practised in sentences; saying them aloud is not heard.

outcomes.text: Narrates with cue cards and reads aloud with stress and pauses.
outcomes.note: Done aloud with a grown-up, who ticks what they heard. The app cannot hear or mark speaking.

outcomes.text: Reads stories, poems and essays for theme, character and tone.
Notices irony, pun, refrain, symbolism and tone in poems.
outcomes.note: Poems are read with questions on figurative language; irony and pun are not asked about on their own.

outcomes.text: Writes narrative and descriptive essays and character sketches.
outcomes.note: Written here or on paper to a task set for this class. The learner checks it against a short list and a grown-up ticks what they see. The app does not keep or mark the writing; the essay studio gives a closer analysis where an evaluator is connected.

outcomes.text: Writes formal letters (complaint, enquiry, request, to the editor) and informal letters.
outcomes.note: Written here or on paper to a task set for this class. The learner checks it against a short list and a grown-up ticks what they see. The app does not keep or mark the writing; the essay studio gives a closer analysis where an evaluator is connected.

outcomes.text: Uses every tense, including the future perfect and future continuous.
Uses determiners, modals and subject-verb agreement.
Uses active and passive voice, and reported speech.
Uses idioms, phrasal verbs, prepositional phrases and pairs of words.
Uses suffixes, abbreviations, clipped and merged words.
Uses every punctuation mark, including colons, semicolons, quotation marks and dashes.
